candidates.desc: Under a spotlight a hand presses into a flat disc of clear slime packed with colorful water beads, then grabs handfuls and squeezes them again and again so the slime bulges out between the fingers.

A woman in a pool pulls her mask on, gives a thumbs up and dives; she swims down to a ring lying on the blue tiles, closes her fingers round it and snatches it up, then shoots to the surface holding it above her head.

From a rooftop terrace a woman feeds a rope out hand over hand so that a wicker basket sinks slowly down the wall to the narrow street below, where a man waiting in the alley catches it and loads it with oranges.

Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.

Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.

A man in a dark jacket and jeans hangs from two red webbing straps clipped to a harness across his chest, suspended in the air high above an unbroken sea of golden clouds at sunrise. He looks down between his boots. The straps let him go and he drops straight away from the camera, shrinking to a small dark speck against the cloud layer. The camera keeps looking down as he disappears into the clouds, and at the end a pale ledge slides into the bottom of the frame.

A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.

A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.

On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.

In a sunny supermarket car park a white delivery van has run into the back corner of a grey car. The car's rear wing is caved in and the tail light is smashed against the van's bumper. Both drivers, in matching blue work shirts, get out and clutch their heads in dismay, then lean over the car's boot photographing the crushed panel with their phones and filling in a form.

A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.

A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

Close-up of an old wooden surface covered in cracked, blistered cream paint. A hand pushes a wide metal scraper under the paint and small chips and flakes break off and fall away, leaving patches of bare orange wood, and the scraper keeps going until a large area is stripped.

Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.

A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.

A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.

A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.

A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

An orange clay tennis court on a sunny evening. A young woman in a white tennis dress and white trainers, her blonde hair in a ponytail, stamps hard on her own racket with one foot, fists clenched and face angry, and a puff of orange dust rises. The racket bends and its strings fly loose, then it lies flat on the clay while she steps back and stands staring down at it, breathing hard. A yellow ball lies nearby, a towel hangs over a wooden bench and a green windscreen covers the fence behind.

In a sunny churchyard in front of an old stone church tower with a clock, a young woman with a long braid, a fleece vest and leather gloves braces her feet and lets a thick rope slide through her hands, lowering a large green bronze bell from a pulley on a scaffold. The bell sinks slowly and settles onto a wooden cradle with sandbags on the grass. Among the gravestones other people watch, one man in black raises his hands, and coiled rope lies on a stone slab.

At a muddy music festival at sunset, a laughing young woman with long braids, a yellow rain jacket and denim shorts pulls hard on a green rubber boot stuck deep in the mud. The boot comes loose with a spray of brown mud, and she falls back and lands sitting in a puddle. Laughing, she holds the boot up high above her head. Behind her friends in clear rain ponchos laugh, and a steward in an orange vest covers his face. Flags fly over a big tent, and a bucket hat, a cup and another boot lie in the mud.

A laughing young woman in a plum satin dress stands barefoot on a long white table at an outdoor evening wedding dinner in an orchard under string lights. She lifts a golden retriever puppy out of a big open wicker hamper, hugs it and holds it up high. A second puppy walks along the table past a half-eaten cake, leaving muddy paw prints on the tablecloth among tipped-over glasses. A young man in a suit at the table reaches out, and guests behind cheer with raised arms.

On a windy sandy beach under a blue sky with white clouds, a young woman in a white linen shirt kneels on all fours on a red and white striped beach shelter and holds it down with her hands and knees, laughing. The wind lifts the shelter higher and higher, and she ends up lying flat on it. Loose metal tent pegs lie in the sand in front of her. Behind her a young man and woman in swimwear run and chase a flying yellow towel and a straw hat near the turquoise sea.

A sunny balcony with a tiled floor, green shutters and an iron railing. A terracotta pot of red geraniums falls, and a young woman in a mustard sweater and black shorts throws herself into the splits and catches it with both hands a moment before it hits the floor, while soil sprays out onto the tiles. She bends over the pot in relief and then laughs. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt watering flowers puts down his metal watering can, laughs and puts a hand to his head. Pots of red flowers sit on the windowsill.
